description: Baselined contrast violations for the semantic-token contrast gate (Requirement 37 AC 2 / Task 56.2). The gate requires every semantic-token pair to clear 7:1 in both light and dark modes. The pairs listed below are below 7:1 today; the gate enforces that they do NOT regress further while they are tightened in follow-up tasks. To remove a row, raise the offending token's contrast in packages/ui/styles/theme.css and delete the entry. The threshold is intentionally a couple of hundredths under the measured value so the gate is robust to floating-point noise. See tools/scripts/README.md.

light.name: accent-foreground / accent
light.note: Teal accent (40% L) vs white text. Tighten by darkening --accent or using neutral-900 as foreground.

light.name: muted-foreground / muted
light.note: Default shadcn muted token. Increase --muted-foreground darkness.

light.name: success / success-bg
light.note: Status pill green-on-tint. Darken --success or lighten --success-bg.

light.name: warning / warning-bg
light.note: Amber on tint — known weak pair; revisit when redesigning status pills.

light.name: error / error-bg
light.note: Red on tint. Darken --error to reach 7:1.

light.name: info / info-bg
light.note: Blue on tint. Darken --info to reach 7:1.

dark.name: primary-foreground / primary
dark.note: Light primary (52% L) with white text. Lighten --primary further or darken --primary-foreground.
